---
title: "Registration"
---

Registration for **GMTD 2026 – Generative Models for Therapeutic Discovery** is now open.

The workshop will take place on **29–30 September 2026** at the **University of Cambridge, William Gates Building**.

Places are limited, so registration is required.

[Register for GMTD 2026](https://onlinesales.admin.cam.ac.uk/conferences-and-events/computer-science-and-technology/workshop-on-generative-models-for-therapeutic-discovery/workshop-on-generative-models-for-therapeutic-discovery-29-30-september-2026){.btn .btn-primary .btn-lg target="_blank"}

## Registration categories

Different registration categories are available through the University of Cambridge Online Store.

The applicable registration fee and eligibility requirements are shown directly on the booking page.

### PhD students

A discounted registration option is available for eligible **PhD students**.

This category requires a registration passcode. If you are eligible and have not yet received the code, please contact the workshop organisers.

## University of Cambridge participants

University of Cambridge staff and students whose registration fee will be covered by their department should **not pay through the Online Store or reclaim the fee through expenses**.

In these cases, payment should instead be arranged through **internal trading / departmental cross-charge**.

University of Cambridge participants who are **self-funding** may register through the Online Store using a personal payment card, provided that they do not subsequently claim the registration fee through expenses.

## Registration and personal data

Registration is managed through the official **University of Cambridge Online Store**.

Information collected during registration will be used for the organisation and delivery of the workshop in accordance with University of Cambridge data-protection policies.

## Questions

For questions about registration, eligibility for the PhD registration category, or any other organisational matter, please contact the GMTD 2026 Organising Committee:

**gmtd.organizing.committee [at] gmail [dot] com**
